title: Yeddude Hakkunde Keewceeral
intro: Aɗa tawa hoore maa e nder leñol ngol luumooji mum en ina njuuti e njulaagu, kono teddeendi mum en ina ɓuuɓtoo ko aldaa e nuunɗal. Nelaaɗo arii e maɓɓe e jeertinaali laaɓtuɗi, kono ɓe njaltii, ɓe njirlotoo, ɓe ngoongɗinii ɓamtaare maɓɓe. Asamaan oo fuɗɗotoo niɓɓiɗde, kono ɓe njiyri ɗum ko barke toɓo. Hol ɓeeɗoo yimɓe?
clues: En mbeltiima e leyɗeele njulaagu e keewal, kono ɓerɗe amen ɓeydii ɓuuɓde.
Nelaaɗo arii e men ina jogii maandeeji ummoraade e joom men, kono en njaltii e jeertinaango makko.
Min nganndiranoo ko njulaagu amen, kono min ndokki peeje juutɗe, min njuumtii ɓesngu nguu.
Min nguuri ko hakkunde leɗɗe ɓutte e leɗɗe ɓutte, kono min ƴettii barkeeji amen e dow majjere.
Nde duule ɓaleeje ɓadtii, min mbeltiima, min cikki maa ɗum addan toɓo e leyɗeele amen joorɗe.
E nder heen, oon ruulde yaltinii jukkungo ɓuuɓngo, min nanngaa e torla ñalawma ɗowdi.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Ɓe njaɓaani nelaaɗo maɓɓe, ɓe njuumri e njulaagu
Ɓe ndewi nagge kaŋŋe, ɓe majjinaama
Ɓe mbaɗatnoo ko sodomiya, ɓe njani e yahooɓe
Ɓe mahi cuuɗi toowɗi, ɓe luulndii Alla
Ɓe calii renndude ndiyam, ɓe bonni gelooɗi debbo
trial.answer: Ɓe njaɓaani nelaaɗo maɓɓe, ɓe njuumri e njulaagu

verse: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway. (15:79)
